description: This file defines FastAPI endpoints for managing event data sources, event metadata, and event timelines within the Fan Engagement Management System. It includes CRUD operations, data validation, business rules enforcement, and interactions with MongoDB helpers.

classes.name: EventMetadataCreateModel
classes.description: Input model for creating and validating event metadata, including business rule validators.

classes.name: EventDataSourceModel
classes.description: Data model for event data source, imported from models.

classes.name: EventMetadataModel
classes.description: Data model for event metadata, imported from models.

classes.name: EventTimelineModel
classes.description: Data model for event timeline, imported from models.

methods.name: create_event_data_source( payload: EventDataSourceModel, helper: EventDataSourceAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_data_source_helper), )
methods.description: Creates a new event data source record.

methods.name: list_event_data_sources( is_active: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="Filter by active status"), helper: EventDataSourceAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_data_source_helper), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of event data sources, optionally filtered by active status.

methods.name: get_event_data_source( ds_id: str, helper: EventDataSourceAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_data_source_helper), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event data source by ID.

methods.name: update_event_data_source( ds_id: str, payload: EventDataSourceModel, helper: EventDataSourceAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_data_source_helper), )
methods.description: Updates an existing event data source by ID.

methods.name: delete_event_data_source( ds_id: str, helper: EventDataSourceAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_data_source_helper), )
methods.description: Deletes an event data source by ID.

methods.name: create_event( payload: EventMetadataCreateModel, helper: EventMetadataAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_metadata_helper), ds_helper: EventDataSourceAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_data_source_helper), )
methods.description: Creates a new event metadata record with validation.

methods.name: list_events( event_type: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by event type"), event_status: Optional[str] = Query(None, alias="status", description="Filter by status"), data_source_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by data source"), start_after: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="Events after this date"), start_before: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="Events before this date"), helper: EventMetadataAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_metadata_helper), )
methods.description: Lists events with optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: get_event_metadata( event_id: str, helper: EventMetadataAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_metadata_helper), )
methods.description: Retrieves a single event metadata record by ID.

methods.name: update_event_metadata( event_id: str, payload: EventMetadataCreateModel, helper: EventMetadataAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_metadata_helper), )
methods.description: Updates existing event metadata by ID.

methods.name: delete_event_metadata( event_id: str, helper: EventMetadataAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_metadata_helper) )

create_event_timeline( payload: EventTimelineModel, event_helper: EventMetadataAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_metadata_helper), helper: EventTimelineAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_timeline_helper), )
methods.description: Creates an event timeline linked to an existing event.

methods.name: list_event_timelines( event_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by event_id"), helper: EventTimelineAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_timeline_helper), )
methods.description: Lists event timelines, optionally filtered by event ID.

methods.name: get_event_timeline( timeline_id: str, helper: EventTimelineAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_timeline_helper), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event timeline by ID.

methods.name: update_event_timeline( timeline_id: str, payload: EventTimelineModel, helper: EventTimelineAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_timeline_helper), )
delete_event_timeline( timeline_id: str, helper: EventTimelineAsyncHelper = Depends(get_event_timeline_helper), )
methods.description: Removes an event timeline by ID.
